PPh 23 dipotong dari pembayaran ke vendo: WHT Art. 23 is withheld from the payment to the vendor (not added like VAT): the expense stays in full, the payable to the vendor is reduced, and the withholding is paid to the state by the 15th of the following month. Income Tax Law Art. 23: 15% dividends, interest, royalties, prizes; 2% asset rental (other than land/buildings) and services. Vendors without NPWP: 100% higher rate.

Pay each period's withholding by the 15th of the following month (journal Dr WHT Art. 23 Payable | Cr Cash/Bank), then enter the slip number from Coretax e-Bupot Unifikasi. There is no netting as with VAT.
